name: jbit
description: JBIT, pronounced jay-bit, for Just Build It. Plans it. Proves it. Sees it through. Turns a goal into one plan file of stages with acceptance checks; builds each stage, verifies it against the running product with evidence kept in the repo, has fresh eyes review it and commits it; and autopilot sees the plan through, still stopping for risky stages, outward steps and decisions that are yours. Also a roadmap of milestones for projects too big for one plan, a quick-fix path for small low-risk changes, a choice of how widely work fans out to agents, and a secret guard on commits.
